correctness.rationale: For f(m)=tau(m²)/2^omega(m²), the p-power factor is (1-u/2+u²/2)/(1-u)². Thus F(s)=zeta(s)^(3/2)H(s) with H analytic via 1+5u²/8+O(u³). Two-term Selberg–Delange gives A=H(1)/Gamma(3/2), B=[Hprime(1)+(3gamma/2-1)H(1)]/Gamma(1/2). Weighting square blocks (2m-1) and substituting m=sqrt(X) gives K0=sqrt(2/pi)H and K1=sqrt(2/pi)[Hprime+(3gamma-1)H/2]. The two-prime lower bound -Hprime/H>(log2)/2+3log3/16>1/2>(3gamma-1)/2 establishes K1<0. Independent rational checks matched square-block sums at X=1,10,100,500,1000. Finite checks do not establish Selberg–Delange.
